item.title: Vulnerability in file transfer software allows authentication bypass
item.description: A vulnerability in managed file transfer software permits an authentication bypass. The advisory says: "Update immediately to version 8.2.1" and describes the impact at length so that the excerpt builder has something realistic to truncate: organisations running the affected versions are exposed to unauthenticated access to administrative interfaces, and the vendor recommends restricting management ports to trusted networks while patches are being rolled out across large environments.
